theorems.name: Submission.cmc_fc_sc_abs_le_mul_mass
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Euclid P)) (X : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (ω : TestFormOn U n) (c : ℝ), 0 < c → X.mass ≠ ∞ → (∀ x, covectorEuclideanNorm ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) x) ≤ c) → |X ω| ≤ c * X.mass.toReal
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
